entities.summary: People's Democratic Republic, a political institution in Yemen during 1962 Revolution and North Yemen Civil War (1963–1970). Grew from Republican Revolution and Egypt deploys 70,000 troops to Yemen — 'Egypt's Vietnam'. Led to the emergence of South Yemen Independence and British.
